story.title: Right To Education
paragraphs_en: In Dayalbhag ,a village near Agra, there lived a girl Anagha . Anagha is a nice and very naughty girl. When Anagha turned 6, she went to a nearby city, Delhi.
In Delhi, she saw a group of childrens wearing uniforms, going to school and playing in the ground. She was so much excited to watch it and asked her parents to let her get admitted in a school.

As her parents cannot afford her education,they remained quiet. One day, the school principal saw Anagha staring at the children going to school. He called Anagha and spoke to her about her interests in studies.

One fine morning, a letter came to Anagha house. In that letter, school principal has stated her to join the school. And also that ,the Government of India will pay her education fees till her degree.
With this news, the whole family rejoiced. Anagha stated going to school from the very nextday. " Right to Education " Law of government, now let one more girl chase her dreams.
